items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I just met this fellow, Manny Jones.

ctx.x: Did you meet any other New Orleans music piano players up in Chicago, except mine?
Well, no, no, I just met this fellow, Manny Jones. And I used to go and listen at, when I, book. You remember book? No.

items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: And then when I was in Chicago I met a fellow by the name of Manny Jones.

ctx.x: That was the Orleans Pleasure Club. That's where I first met Jellarole Morton. Oh he was around then? He was around. Jellarole Morton used to come play for us every Monday. We used to cook bean dinners for him. He would come play sometimes, cook a cow and dinner for him or so like that you know and he would come on. And then when I was in Chicago I met a fellow by the name of Manny Jones. I don't know if you know Manny Jones.
Oh yes, Richard M. Jones, yeah I knew him.
